fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced urban plant; controlled vehicle gates in the steel perimeter fence off N Paramount Blvd confirmed in Street View (2022/2025). Truck access is gated.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No distinct freestanding guard-booth structure beside a truck lane was visible in imagery. A modern office building sits at the north entrance — check-in is likely handled at/near the office rather than a standalone booth. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true (truck gate present, no visible standalone guard shack) — but this is a medium-confidence inference; security may be office-based or staffed in a way not resolvable from overhead/Street View.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Tight urban site directly on N Paramount Blvd, a busy arterial; little stacking room outside the gates so a truck queue could spill toward the road.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Old (1972) tightly-built urban manufacturing plant; building covers most of the 30-acre parcel. Dock doors are tucked along interior building faces — ~10 estimated, band 0-10.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Outdoor space is used mainly for stacked metal/parts racks and equipment storage rather than a trailer drop yard; very few free-standing trailers visible.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: At least 2 vehicle gates in the perimeter fence (north entrance off Paramount plus additional access) — count is approximate.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the far west of the industrial district but does not clearly spur into the TABC property; treated as not rail-served.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: One large multi-section manufacturing complex (stamping/welding/cat-converter) plus support structures and a separate office building — single operational facility, not a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Web sources cite ~30 acres; parcel boundaries in the dense industrial district are hard to delineate from imagery — perimeter box estimates ~27 acres.
